name: liq-gap
description: Binance liquidity indicators and trading signal system (Express.js + Vanilla JS dashboard)

scripts.build:linux: PKG_CACHE_PATH=./.pkg-cache node scripts/build-obfuscate.js linux && PKG_CACHE_PATH=./.pkg-cache pkg package.json -t node18-linux-x64 --output liq-gap-linux
scripts.build:macos: PKG_CACHE_PATH=./.pkg-cache node scripts/build-obfuscate.js macos && PKG_CACHE_PATH=./.pkg-cache pkg package.json -t node18-macos-arm64 --output liq-gap-macos
